landing.support: Pick places on a beautiful map, build days you can walk, journal on the road, and share.
landing.trust.title: Built for days you actually walk
landing.trust.support: Quiet confidence from the same map thread — plan, move, journal, share.
landing.trust.quote: The itinerary finally lived on the map — roads we walked, not chords between pins.
landing.trust.attribution: Solo & collab travelers on Beaver Plan
landing.trust.signal1.label: Real roads
landing.trust.signal1.detail: Routes follow path geometry from the map engine — Google by default, Amap in mainland China.
landing.trust.signal2.label: Same trip thread
landing.trust.signal2.detail: Journal on the road and export share cards from the footprint you already planned.
landing.trust.signal3.label: Street-ready translate
landing.trust.signal3.detail: Two-way talk and dual-camera captions when the language on the corner shifts.
landing.pillars.title: What stays with the trip
landing.pillars.support: Five product pillars — one luminous travel OS, not a pile of tools.
landing.pillars.map.title: Map itinerary
landing.pillars.map.body: Places and days live on geography — pins, routes, and intel in one frame.
landing.pillars.transit.title: Real transit
landing.pillars.transit.body: Walk, ride, transfer — routing that follows roads, not straight chords.
landing.pillars.journal.title: Journal & share
landing.pillars.journal.body: Write on the road, then export social cards from the same footprint.
landing.pillars.translate.title: Live translate
landing.pillars.translate.body: Two-way talk and dual-camera captions when the street language shifts.
landing.pillars.ux.title: Designed UX
landing.pillars.ux.body: Daylight chrome, azure signal, map-first craft — built to feel walked, not demoed.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.support: Three moves from blank map to a trip worth walking.
landing.how.step1.title: Drop places
landing.how.step1.body: Search a city, pin stops, and watch the route stage light up.
landing.how.step2.title: Shape the days
landing.how.step2.body: Order stops, generate walkable legs, invite companions to co-edit.
landing.how.step3.title: Carry it with you
landing.how.step3.body: Journal, share a card, and translate on the street — same trip thread.
landing.finale.title: Start a trip worth walking
landing.finale.support: Open the map, drop a few places, and let the days take shape — luminous chrome, same thread on the road.
landing.finale.meta: Map-first travel OS · plan, walk, journal, share.
